method: tests/fl41_operator_mutation_check.py: one mutation per function per round at EVERY site of the lifted code: binary operators (+ - & | ^ << >> == != < > <= >=), sign casts (int8/16/32 <-> unsigned), and the constant operand of compares and of add/sub immediates (cmpconst, aluimm). The direct C test and the Unicorn differential test (fixtures extended with 40 boundary-value recipes per row, tests/fl39d_boundary_recipes.json) are both run; a mutant is killed when either fails. A survivor is explained when gcc -O2 compiles the mutant function to the same instructions as the port (counted in survived_identical_gcc_O2) or when a per-survivor reason is written (explained). Anything else is unexplained and the row is pending.
literal_pass: the pass over every other integer literal (store values, offsets) was still running when this file was written; its survivors are handled in the next slice
